correctness.rationale: For g=I+N over characteristic two, N²=0 iff uv=0,vw=0,ut+sw=0. The central z is free. With v=0, X=((u,s),(w,t)) is rank ≤1 and counts S=q³+q²−q matrices. A fixed nonzero rank-one X commutes under the middle commutator constraint exactly with rank-one X' sharing its row line or column line, giving q²+q²−q matrices. Classify by v≠0, v=0 and (u,w)≠0, v=u=w=0 with (s,t)≠0, and central z-only. The four c_I sizes and multiplicities follow and sum to |I|=2q⁴−q²; weighted sum q⁸+2q⁷−2q⁵ and probability tending 1/4. Independent full centralizer recomputation over F2 and F4 from fresh multiplication formulas confirmed all members (28 and 496 involutions) and four strata, not merely representatives.
